mapper.select: SELECT val FROM sn_seq WHERE name = #{name}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sn_seq(name, val) VALUES (#{name}, #{val}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE val = #{val}
INSERT IGNORE INTO sn_audit_archive SELECT a.*, UTC_TIMESTAMP() FROM sn_audit a WHERE a.created_at < #{upper} AND a.created_at >= #{lower}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sn_audit_archive WHERE created_at < #{cutoff} LIMIT #{limit}
DELETE FROM sn_gen_preview WHERE created_at < DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
DELETE FROM sn_rate_counter WHERE win < DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
